<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[June 2019 Mali massacre]] 
**An attack on a village near the town of [[Sangha, Mali|Sangha]] in central [[Mali]] kills 95 [[Dogon people|Dogon]] villagers. The mayor of nearby [[Bankass]] blames local [[Fula people|Fulani]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-48579475 (BBC News)]
*[[Boko Haram]] [[Militants|militants]] attacked the town of [[Darak]] in [[Cameroon|Cameroon’s]] Far North Region bordering [[Lake Chad]], killing 21 soldiers and 16 civilians. Several Boko Haram attackers were also killed. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/africa/2019-06/12/c_138135372.htm (xinhuanet)]
;Arts and culture
*The [[Holy See|Vatican]] issues a teaching instruction, ''Male and Female He Created Them'', which criticizes the theory of [[gender]] as being more complex than the binary division of sexes. The document draws criticism from [[LGBT]] groups. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-48584892 (BBC News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Arms industry|Defense contractors]] [[United Technologies]] and [[Raytheon]] agree to merge into a combined company  that would generate $74 billion in annual sales, making it the second-largest aerospace and defense company in the U.S. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/06/10/raytheon-united-technologies-to-merge-what-experts-are-watching.html (CNBC)] [https://www.bloomberg.com/opinion/articles/2019-06-09/raytheon-is-united-technologies-50-billion-finishing-touch (Bloomberg)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A man died and 15 others are injured after an accidental explosion at the building of the [[Comune]] in [[Rocca di Papa]], [[Italy]]. [[Emanuele Crestini]], the mayor of the city, was critically injured and died ten days later from his injuries, bringing the death toll to two. [https://roma.corriere.it/notizie/cronaca/19_giugno_21/rocca-papa-sindaco-emanuele-crestini-morto-eroe-uscito-ultimo-salvare-dipendenti-08b6d5ea-93ed-11e9-bbab-6778bdcd7550.shtml (''Corriere della Sera'')]
*[[List of earthquakes in 2019|Earthquakes in 2019]]
**A magnitude 4.0 earthquake is reported in [[Northeast Ohio]]. No damage has been reported. [https://www.news5cleveland.com/news/local-news/oh-cuyahoga/clevelanders-report-feeling-earthquake-monday-morning (News 5 Cleveland)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/4-0-earthquake-reported-northeast-ohio-n1015776 (NBC News)] 
**A helicopter crashes onto the roof of the [[AXA Equitable Center]] in [[New York City]], killing the pilot. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/06/10/nyregion/helicopter-crash-nyc.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Health and environment
*[[Phase-out of lightweight plastic bags]]
**[[Prime Minister of Canada|Canadian Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] announces that [[Canada]] will ban all single-use plastics as early as 2021 in a bid to significantly reduce [[plastic pollution]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-48477087 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[McStay family murder]]
**In [[San Bernardino, California]], Charles "Chase" Merritt is found guilty of four counts of murder in the 2013 deaths of the McStay family. [https://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-mcstay-family-murders-verdict-20190610-story.html (''The Los Angeles Times'')]
*[[Rape in India]]
**An [[India]]n court convicts six men in the 2018 rape and murder of an eight-year-old girl near [[Kathua]] in the [[States and territories of India|state]] of [[Jammu and Kashmir (state)|Jammu and Kashmir]]. Three of the men are given life sentences while the other three, found guilty of destroying evidence, receive five-year prison terms. [https://www.npr.org/2019/06/10/731323696/indian-court-convicts-6-men-in-rape-and-murder-of-8-year-old-girl (NPR)]
*Former [[Boston Red Sox]] star [[David Ortiz]] returns to [[Boston]] to recover from a shooting in the [[Dominican Republic]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/david-ortiz-shot-dominican-republic-nightclub-returns-boston-hospital-today-2019-06-10/ (CBS News)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**Two hundred [[Myanmar Army]] troops surround Pauktawbyin monastery in [[Rakhine State]], demanding that they be allowed entry to search for [[Arakan Army (Kachin State)|Arakan Army]] insurgents possibly hiding in an IDP camp within the monastery. The head monk initially refused, saying that they would only allow inspections by people in civilian clothes, but later permitted their entry. [https://www.rfa.org/english/news/myanmar/surround-06102019153007.html (RFA)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Nechirvan Barzani]] is sworn in as the new [[President of Iraqi Kurdistan]]. In his first speech as President, Barzani says he will seek to improve ties with [[Baghdad]], and create a joint-security plan to prevent [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] from re-emerging in the region. [http://www.rudaw.net/english/kurdistan/100620191 (Rudaw)]
*[[United States House of Representatives|Congressman]] [[Justin Amash]] announces that he will leave the [[Freedom Caucus]], weeks after calling for the [[Efforts to impeach Donald Trump|impeachment]] of [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.politico.com/amp/story/2019/06/10/justin-amash-house-freedom-caucus-1359614 (Politico)]
